semiconductor_relevance: High — Sojitz Machinery Europe GmbH provides specialized equipment and support services for the semiconductor industry, particularly in packaging and assembly.
summary: Sojitz Machinery Europe GmbH focuses on trading and providing equipment, parts, and services for various industries, including semiconductor manufacturing. They offer advanced systems such as high-speed bonders and laser jetting systems specifically designed for MEMS and PCB substrate applications.
capabilities: High Speed Bonder System for soldering probes onto probe cards
Laser Jetting System for mounting micro solder balls
Equipment for MEMS packaging and PCB substrate manufacturing

regional_presence.Europe: Sojitz Machinery Europe GmbH was established in 2022 to enhance their activities and provide professional support to customers and partners in Europe.
